version_note: v113: user-directed live hard-stop replacement. On every completed post-fill minute, test the full remaining long size against fresh bid-side executable VWAP before any policy-bar update; if VWAP is at or below the immutable initial loss threshold, cancel the native stop and submit a reduce-only market exit. Native Kraken stop remains an emergency backstop. No entry, admission, score, trailing, smooth-protection, fast-adverse, timeout, or policy parameter changes.
execution_adjusted_ev: raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - (1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_vwap_impact_bps + 10 bps); resulting executable EV must be >= +30 bps after frozen dual MC1 admission and the common portfolio auction; final veto only, never reranking.
protective_stop: native exchange reduce-only stop-market; trigger targets full-position bid-side VWAP at entry and remains the emergency backstop behind the completed-minute full-VWAP initial hard-stop monitor.
position_monitor: persistent one-minute controller: fresh full remaining-size bid-VWAP initial hard stop -> prior smooth lock -> trailing -> fast adverse -> next-bar MFE/arm. Initial hard stop uses immutable entry-time signal ATR and is evaluated before completed-bar state updates. Adaptive Exit V1 only modulates parent trailing activation.
